get.description: Retrieve details of a specific contract change using the change ID. The response includes the change status and description of its line item changes.

parameters.name: changeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract change to retrieve.

patch.description: Update a specific contract change in your HubSpot account. This allows you to update the name, change effective date, and line item changes.

parameters.name: changeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract change to update.

post.description: Accept a specific direct change identified by the changeId. This will apply the change to the target Contract, and return the updated change description with ACCEPTED status. Only direct changes may be accepted through this endpoint.

parameters.name: changeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract change to accept.

post.description: Cancel a specific contract change identified by its changeId. On successful cancellation the updated change is returned with CANCELED status.

parameters.name: changeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract change to cancel.

post.description: Create a new contract in your HubSpot account using the Commerce Contracts API. This operation requires a request body with necessary contract details, including line items, billing information, and seller details. The contract will be created with the specified properties and a URL to the newly created resource will be provided in the response.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

get.description: Retrieve the details of a specific contract using its unique identifier. The response includes comprehensive information about a contract, including its status, line items, and associated metadata.

parameters.name: contractId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract to retrieve.

patch.description: Update properties and associations of an existing contract in your HubSpot account using the specified contract ID. This endpoint allows you to modify contract details such as name, billing information, seller information, automated tax enablement, and more.

parameters.name: contractId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract to update.

get.description: Retrieve the list of changes associated with a specific contract. This includes complete information about changes made against the contract, including draft, canceled and accepted changes.

parameters.name: contractId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract for which changes are being retrieved.

post.description: Create a new change for a specific contract in your HubSpot account. These changes are used to alter line items on the contract from a specific change effective date. Two change types are supported: QUOTE changes result are controlled by Change Quotes, and DIRECT changes are controlled directly.

parameters.name: contractId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract for which the change is being created.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

post.description: Create a renewal quote for a specific contract in your HubSpot account. Includes specification of contract and quote template. The response includes a URL to the newly created resource.

parameters.name: contractId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract for which the renewal quote is being created.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

post.description: Schedule termination for an existing contract in your HubSpot account. This operation requires specifying the contract ID and a termination date. It may be called again to alter the scheduled termination date.
